title: Prism's Purple Emerald
description: a simple retexture pack that replaces emeralds with a vibrant purple version, maintaining the original vanilla look and feel.
body:
![Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/385779bc4a659e0c44ed98aca32a6abb69bbbd3d.png)

**transforming the classic emerald into a rich vibrant purple gem giving your world a fresh and mystical feel.**

**this pack retextures all emerald-related blocks, replacing the traditional green with deep violet tones while keeping the vanilla style intact.**

### - changes
- Emerald items retextured to purple
- Emerald ores updated with purple gem accents
- Deepslate Emerald ore Retextured
- Emerald Blocks designed with a purple color palette
- maintains vanilla shading and style
